author: BourbonBonobo
body:
•  IGN: Kryptological (Past: AeroScape, canuck_pro) 
  •  Skype: BeastGaming_
  •  Past team Experience: Fortissimus
  •  Bow or Sword?: Sword
  •  Activeness: As of right now I'm not super active because I'm currently building a new computer/getting new computer accessories, but when that's done, I'll be more active!
  •  Minecraft strengths: I'm great at pvp, awesome at Control the hill, At or near expert marksman, I'm great at both defending and building defenses, I enjoy playing midfield, I'm good at pushing against the other team (helps rushers), I'm an excellent builder, I like to help supply the team with supplies (Tools, blocks, Armor).
  • Weaknesses:  I'm not great at rushing, I'm not the best at maintaining long kill streaks (if I'm not wearing diamond/enchanted armor), I sometimes can get angry at myself (I think everyone does), I'm not super fast at bridging, I've never attempted ninja bridging (I wouldn't mind training) 
  • Team Strengths: If I'm active, I'll do my best to participate, I'm a kind person overall, and I care about making friendships with other teammates.
  • Final thoughts: I'm looking for a position in a team that wants to have fun, not be super competitive, I would like a position in midfield if possible, if not, I'd prefer defender

   Thanks guys! 


  -From,


 Kryptological :P <3 <3
